meta.description: Base layer: Open StreetMap

ECOSTRESS instrument mounted on the International Space Station. Data shows land surface temperatures measured during early afternoon hours in °C. The map is composed of single observations acquired between June 1st to June 24th, in order to result in an almost cloud-free image.

Risk of drought impact for agriculture, **latest 10-day update**, **global**, from the Global Drought Observatory. It combines the hazard (precipitation, soil moisture and vegetation condition) with exposure and vulnerability.

How to read: darker classes mean higher risk that drought hits crops and rural livelihoods.

attribution.text: Copernicus Emergency Management Service, Global Drought Observatory (JRC)

meta.description:
Fine particle (PM2.5) concentration near the surface, **latest CAMS forecast**, **global**.

How to read: use it to compare regions and follow pollution episodes linked to health risk. This is a live model forecast, so the map changes over time; official exposure figures come from monitoring stations.

attribution.text: Generated using Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service information 2026

meta.description: Land cover map for 2020 with statistics by NUTS.  Click on the "Statistics" tab and then select a geographic area of interest.

A 10 meter resolution global land cover product for the year 2021, developed and validated in near-real time based on Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 data.  Data is provided with statistics for NUTS (Nomenclature of territorial units for statistics) boundaries.  Select the "statistics" tab and click on a feature to view.
Global land cover maps for 2020 and 2021 at 10 m. Use the time slider to switch between the two years.
Above ground biomass (AGB) in t/ha in 20 m spatial resolution created with the BIOMASAR method using Sentinel-1 and ALOS 2 PALSAR 2 data.
World Cereal spring cereals, globally, at 10m resolution in specific seasons throughout the year.
World Cereal winter cereals, globally, at 10m resolution in specific seasons throughout the year.

World Cereal temporary crops, globally, at 10m resolution in specific seasons throughout the year.  A piece of land that is sowed/planted and harvestable at least once within the 12 months after the sowing/planting date.
Global maps of maize for 2021, at 10m resolution.
European soil-organic-carbon layer supporting soil health, carbon-stock context, and land-condition assessment.

Change in tree cover presence between **2015 and 2018**, **pan-European (EEA-39)** at **20 m**, from the Copernicus High Resolution Layer Tree Cover Change Mask.

How to read: red marks tree cover lost, green marks new tree cover, greys are unchanged areas with or without trees.

attribution.text: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS), HRL Tree Cover Change Mask 2015-2018

meta.description:
Annual median NDVI composite from Sentinel-2 for **2021**, **global** at **10 m**, produced as an input to the ESA WorldCover 2021 map.

How to read: higher values mean denser, greener vegetation; bare soil, built-up areas and water score low.

attribution.text: ESA WorldCover project / Copernicus Sentinel data, via Terrascope

Change in built-up areas between **2018 and 2021**, **pan-European (EEA-38 + UK)** at **20 m**, from the Copernicus High Resolution Layer Impervious Built-up Change.

How to read: red is new built-up cover, dark green is lost cover, amber and light green show built-up density going up or down, grey is unchanged built-up land.

attribution.text: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS), HRL Impervious Built-up Change 2018-2021
